correctness.rationale: For char5 hyperelliptic y²=x^10+x^7+ax^4+bx=x h(x³) with h=t³+t²+at+b, bΔ≠0 is exactly squarefree genus4. Independent symbolic expansion of F² reproduces Cartier pre-fifth-root 4x4 coefficient matrix with isolated U=a²+2b scalar and complementary three-block. The latter has rank2 on the smooth locus; its squared Cartier scalar D=b²(2a+1)^5+2[2(a+b)]^5 controls eventual rank2 versus nilpotence. Thus a_J=1+1_{U=0}, p-rank=1_{U!=0}+2 1_{D!=0}. On U=0, b=2a²; exact char5 factorizations Δ=2a²(a-2)² and D=3a⁴(a-2)^5(a+1) leave unique smooth p-rank0 pair (4,2). The given exact point counts 6,36,126,576 over F5^n, n=1..4, plus Weil functional equation give zeta numerator (1+5T²)^2(1-5T²+25T⁴); cyclotomic normalization proves all slopes1/2, so unique supersingular member. Independently reconstructed symbolic Cartier matrix, factorizations and all 17 smooth base-field parameter strata. Did not independently rerun the 5^4 extension-field point counter; checked its algorithm and Newton identity implications.
